title: Graduate Electronic Systems Engineer (2026 start)
Virtual Youth Group Coach
description:
Build The Next Generation Of Youth Coaching
About Us
At tapouts , we believe in the boundless potential of every child. Our mission goes beyond teaching skills; we are dedicated to nurturing the emotional and psychological well-being of the next generation. Imagine being part of a team that transforms the lives of a million children and their families. By joining tapouts , you are not just taking on a job but using your talents for a deeply rewarding cause.
About the role
We seek energetic, experienced Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) coaches to lead and facilitate live online group sessions for youth. As a tapouts SEL Coach, you'll create a fun, engaging, and emotionally safe virtual environment where kids build confidence, self-regulation, and connection with their peers.
As a tapouts SEL Coach, you will:

• Lead live online SEL group sessions for youth ages 4-16 years

• Deliver structured social-emotional learning activities and games that build self-awareness, emotional regulation, and interpersonal skills

• Build positive relationships with participants and foster an inclusive, emotionally safe group space

• Manage group dynamics and respond calmly to behavioral or emotional disruptions during live sessions

• Monitor and assess individual and group progress

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Psychology, Education, Social Work, or a related field (Mandatory), Master's degree is preferred

• At least 2 years of experience leading live group sessions with children in a virtual or online setting

• At least 5 years of experience designing or leading structured group sessions or programs for children

• SEL, coaching, or mental-health-specific certification is strongly preferred (e.g., ICF, IPEC, PPS Credential, CASEL, Mental Health First Aid)

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Comfortable using Zoom and Google Suite as day-to-day coaching tools

• Availability for a minimum of 10 hours per week to provide coaching within tapouts peak hours (1-8 pm PT) during weekdays and weekends (6am-8pm PT). Example schedule: Mondays (2pm-6pm), Thursdays (5pm-8pm), Saturdays (8am-11am) and Sundays (6 a.m. to 6:30 p.m.)

• A fast, reliable internet connection and a quiet working space

This position is remote, 100% online coaching position is a part-time independent 1099 contractor position that offers you the flexibility to work evenings and weekends as needed.
Our Application Process
Because our coaches lead every session live over video, all applicants are required to complete a short video interview as part of our recruitment process. This step allows us to see your energy and communication style on camera, and applications cannot move forward without it.
Our Commitment to Building a Diverse, Equitable, and Inclusive Workforce
tapouts is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, or age.
Join us in our mission to empower children with the social and emotional skills they need to succeed!

title: CEO Attaché
description:
Molecule and BIO.xyz are building the foundation of Decentralized Science (DeSci) - where biotech meets web3 to make scientific research community-owned, transparent, and faster to market.
Molecule provides the infrastructure to turn intellectual property (IP) into programmable, on-chain assets through our IP-NFT framework and evolving protocol stack. This enables researchers, patients, and communities to fund and govern biotech projects in new, open ways.
is the coordination and economic layer of DeSci, powering BioDAOs through funding, governance, and ecosystem alignment.
Together, we are creating a new model for scientific discovery - one where breakthroughs are owned and advanced by the communities that believe in them.
Full-time | Globally flexible, but US preferred - Travel required | Start: Immediately
We’re looking for a sharp, commercially-minded operator to work directly alongside Molecule’s CEO. This role sits at the centre of everything - driving BD pipeline, managing investor relationships, handling high-priority communications with enterprise pharma partners, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks in a fast-moving organisation.
Molecule’s Commercial Team runs a high volume of concurrent partnerships across pharma, biotech, academic institutions, and investors. Deals get introduced, calls happen, and then things need someone relentless to keep them moving. You’ll work closely with the CEO and our Commercial Team to manage the pipeline, maintain investor relations across 70+ existing investors, and build the systems that make all of this scalable.
This is a role for someone who can context-switch between a pharma licensing conversation and an investor update without missing a beat - and who understands why what Molecule is building matters for the future of drug development.
What You’ll Do

• Own follow-through on BD pipeline - track active deal workstreams across enterprise, academic, and biotech partnerships, ensure nothing stalls, and surface the right opportunities to leadership at the right time

• Manage and build investor relations - maintain relationships with 70+ existing investors through regular updates, slide decks, and follow-ups, and drive new investor relationships forward alongside the CEO and the Commercial Team.

• Triage enterprise, pharma, and investor correspondence with sound commercial judgement

• Coordinate and prepare for high-stakes calls and meetings across time zones, ensuring the Team walks into every conversation fully briefed

• Draft and refine investor communications, partnership proposals, and internal updates on behalf of the Commercial Team

• Build and maintain a commercial system - create structure around how BD opportunities are categorised, tracked, and reported internally (think: our own lean CRM)

• Coordinate cross-functional deal activity - many of Molecule’s BD engagements span organisations and teams; you’ll be the connective tissue that keeps everyone aligned

• Analyse the science behind partnerships - evaluate incoming opportunities with enough scientific literacy to triage what’s worth pursuing and brief leadership accordingly

• Jump on calls with partners and investors as a credible representative of Molecule when needed

Who You Are

• You have previously worked in a VC fund

• You’re commercially hungry. Whether you came from tech sales at a startup, BD at a health-tech company, or you taught yourself commercial skills alongside your academic work - you understand pipeline, follow-up, and what it takes to close

• You’re not typically corporate. We’re not looking for someone who climbed the ladder at a large pharma company. We want someone scrappy - think a biotech startup, or someone who hustled their way through a top programme and is now looking for real ownership

description:

Requirements

• The ability to review and interpret data and activity in order to make accurate decisions.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross- functional teams.

• Strong interpersonal skills.

• Knowledge and understanding of the rules and regulations of the gaming industry.

• The ability to adapt to changing priorities and to thrive in a fast- paced work environment.

• Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays.

What’s in it for you?
We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

• Competitive pay and benefits

• Start-up culture backed by a secure, global brand

• Potential Hybrid Scheduling

• Opportunity to shape and develop risk-based AML monitoring strategies, processes and create a best-in-class customer experience for the Hard Rock Digital community

Roster of Uniques
We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

title: Senior Full-Stack & Cloud Engineer (Contract - 6 months)
description:
We are seeking a hands-on Senior Full-Stack & Cloud Engineer to take technical ownership of an internally developed web application and transition it into a secure, reliable, and maintainable production solution. The application was rapidly developed using Claude Code and VS Code and will initially support approximately 100 internal employees. The successful candidate will assess and strengthen the existing codebase, establish appropriate engineering and security standards, implement a sustainable hosting and deployment model, and provide ongoing technical support and enhancements. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who is comfortable working with AI-assisted development while bringing the engineering judgment required to ensure production applications are secure, maintainable, and reliable.

About the Role

• Take technical ownership of the existing application, including reviewing and understanding the AI-generated codebase.

• Identify technical debt, security vulnerabilities, and architectural risks, and refactor where appropriate without unnecessarily rebuilding working parts.

• Develop and maintain front-end, back-end, API, and database functionality, and build new features as business needs evolve.

• Establish coding, documentation, testing, and code-review standards.

• Design and maintain simple, secure, cost-effective hosting with separate development/test and production environments.

• Implement automated CI/CD pipelines with a documented deployment and rollback process.

• Manage configuration, secrets, certificates, and domains, and establish backup and recovery processes.

• Implement monitoring, logging, error tracking, and alerting, and track reliability, performance, and cost.

• Implement SSO-based authentication, role-based access control, least-privilege permissions, and audit logging.

• Conduct a production-readiness assessment, execute a prioritized remediation plan, and partner with IT/security to meet organizational requirements.

About You 

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience owning production applications.

• Strong full-stack development capabilities using modern web technologies.

• Experience inheriting, evaluating, and improving existing codebases.

• Experience deploying and supporting applications in a major cloud or managed hosting environment.

• Strong understanding of Git-based software-development workflows.

• Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments.

• Working knowledge of relational databases, database security, migrations, and backups.

• Experience implementing authentication, authorization, SSO, OAuth and/or OpenID Connect.

• Strong understanding of application-security fundamentals, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

• Experience implementing production logging, monitoring, alerting, and error tracking.

• Ability to independently troubleshoot production issues across the application and infrastructure stack.

Preferred Experience

• Experience supporting internal enterprise applications.

• Experience integrating applications with Microsoft Entra ID/Azure AD, Okta, Google Workspace, or similar enterprise identity platforms.

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Pulumi.

Hourly Pay Range: $50.00 -$60.00 USD

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!&

title: Deputy General Counsel, Head of Americas Legal
locationText: New York, United States; San Jose, California, United States; United States (US)
description:
About the Team

OKX’s Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to the company across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth and development by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced group of lawyers who enjoy the cutting-edge nature of our work and our industry.

 

Our Americas Legal team is the primary legal partner to OKX's regulated businesses across the Americas region, advising on a broad range of topics including regulatory strategy, regulatory licensing, product launches, strategic partnerships and corporate matters. The Americas Legal team works cross-functionally with leaders across the company to help build and scale an innovative and compliant OKX platform.

About the Opportunity

This is an essential, high-profile role at one of the fastest-growing global cryptocurrency exchanges based in San Jose, CA. The Deputy General Counsel will play a central role in proactively shaping OKX's regulatory and legal strategy in the US and across the Americas. The Deputy General Counsel will act as a key partner and provide day-to-day counsel to senior business leadership of OKX's US business, including the coordination of efforts with Compliance, Risk, Operations, Finance and other functions. The Deputy General Counsel will stay abreast of all regulatory changes applicable to the digital asset space in the US, promptly communicate developments to OKX's senior business leadership, and help guide the business in identifying growth opportunities in the US. The position will coordinate the efforts of the legal function serving OKX's business in the US as well as the Americas more broadly, and will report to OKX's VP, Legal.

 

You'll work at the intersection of law, regulations, and product innovation - driving complex licensing initiatives, advising senior stakeholders on questions without clear precedent, and helping the business move quickly through an evolving regulatory landscape. We are looking for a hands-on legal leader with sharp judgment, strong interpersonal skills, and the desire to work with a top-notch legal team. The right candidate is not afraid to jump into novel and complex matters, and is willing to roll up their sleeves and work effectively under time pressure. We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services.

What You’ll Be Doing

•
Develop and advance a best-in-class regulatory strategy in the US and across the Americas, including the development and maintenance of strong relationships with regulators.

•
Engage directly with regulators and business counterparties as a key point of contact for OKX, as well as interacting on a daily basis with senior executives at OKX.

•
Identify growth opportunities and strategic initiatives based on proactive, timely, actionable analysis of US regulatory developments.

•
Lead and manage attorneys covering various Americas regions so that legal efforts are coordinated and consistently achieve successful outcomes.

•
Manage a wide range of legal requests and advise on legal risk with an eye toward achieving the strategic goals of the company's regional business leaders.

What We Look For In You

•
Strong communication and leadership skills, and excellent judgment

•
Self-starter who can contribute as both an individual and a team member, with limited reliance upon external counsel.

•
Membership with a US state bar or equivalent.

•
12+ years of regulatory experience dealing with financial services laws and regulations in a highly-regulated environment.

•
Prior experience can be in-house at a regulated financial firm or in the crypto industry (preferable), at a top-tier law firm, and/or at a regulator.

•
Experience driving projects to completion on expedited timelines.

•
Must be highly-driven, proa

description:
Licensed Mental Health Professional (LCSW/LMFT/LPC/LMHC) 62 K-80K/yr

FLSA Status: Exempt

Salary:

62K - 80K+

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

The Agent Platform team gives Netflix engineers the infrastructure to go from zero to a production-grade AI agent without reinventing the wheel. We own the foundational building blocks the whole company builds on: the Model Gateway (unified access to external LLMs like Claude, GPT, and Gemini), the Assistance API for conversational use cases, the MCP Gateway that connects agents to Netflix 's internal systems and knowledge, our Agent SDK, and an end-to-end evaluation stack.
The work has moved well beyond chat completions. • Strong fundamentals in building and operating scalable, observable, fault-tolerant distributed systems.

• Proficiency in Python (and Python packaging tooling) plus one of Java, Go, C/C++, Rust, or Zig. Familiarity with our stack - Temporal, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes - is a plus.

• You have a demonstrated ability to use data and insights, including business metrics and user research, to substantiate design decisions and drive impact.

• You are innately collaborative and actively manage stakeholders. Your collaborative style inspires others, and you build the dependability needed to enact influence with cross-functional partners.

• You excel at untangling ambiguity, breaking down complex workflows into intuitive, end-to-end user journeys.

• You understand what it means to design for speed and reliability - your instinct is to reduce friction, not add features.

• You take an AI-first design approach to quickly create conceptual prototypes but also possess strong visual design skills to polish beautiful and intuitive end-to-end journeys across multiple surfaces.

description:
About WorkOS 🚀

WorkOS builds modern developer tools and APIs that make it easy for companies to become Enterprise Ready. Our platform powers authentication, identity, authorization, and other critical infrastructure that developers need to securely scale their products to large organizations.

We recently raised a $100M Series C, valuing the company at $2B, led by Meritech and Sapphire with participation from Greenoaks, Craft, Abstract, and Audacious. WorkOS powers enterprise features for many of the fastest-growing AI companies, including OpenAI, Cursor, and Perplexity, Sierra, and Plaid.

As AI reshapes software, WorkOS is at the frontier of Human and Agent Authentication, Identity, and Access Control helping companies answer a new critical question: who are your agents, and what are they allowed to do? Our fast-growing customer base includes hundreds of modern software companies building the next generation of enterprise-ready products.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Data team at WorkOS plays a central role on the company operations to ensure information and insights are accurate and available from any surface, whether that's a visualization tool or an agent's response, to accelerate company growth and scale. The team owns WorkOS's internal data platform end to end: ingestion, orchestration, the Snowflake warehouse, dbt transformations, governance and access controls. We also own the consumption layer: the reverse-ETL syncs that land data in Salesforce and Slack, the semantic views that agents query, the definitions that keep reporting consistent across the company, and the visualization tooling the company uses (ask us about Flashboards https://workos.com/blog/reporting-tool-with-no-editor).

We run on an agent-first operating system: we are a lean team that moves fast, we document so agents can execute, and AI agents query the warehouse, run our runbooks, and open pull requests alongside us. We trust each other's expertise, we work out loud and in the open, and not opposed to rapid experimentation to get to the right solution for the business.

We're hiring a Data Engineer to own and evolve the systems that move, transform, protect, and serve data across our internal warehouse. title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
*ALL CANDIDATES MUST BE LOCATED IN PORTUGAL*

About IntermediaAre you looking for a company where YOUR VOICE is heard? Where can you MAKE A DIFFERENCE? Do you THRIVE in a FAST-PACED work environment? Do you wake every morning EXCITED to work with GREAT PEOPLE and create SUCCESS TOGETHER? Then Intermedia is the place for you.

Intermedia has established itself as a leading provider of cloud communications and collaboration tech that allows companies to connect better. We have a strong track record of growth, profitability, and creating an environment where everyone matters. Everyone. While we are fast-paced and admittedly a bit intense, we promise that you won’t be bored. You will find Intermedia is a place where you can indulge your passion for creating and supporting great cloud technology. What’s more, we always look to promote from within and have many employees who have been with us 10, 15, and 20+ years!
Culture at Intermedia is built on teamwork and transparency. We hold each other accountable and always have each other’s back! While primarily remote, this role requires occasional visits to the office in Coimbra or in Aveiro. We plan to open an office in Porto in the future. This approach gives team members the flexibility to work remotely while also coming together in the office for collaboration and teamwork.
Are you ready to make your mark? About the Role We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to improve the reliability of our AI and analytics platforms and the services that depend on them. As Intermedia expands its global product deployments, this role will strengthen SRE practices across production infrastructure, data pipelines, machine-learning services, customer-facing analytics, and AI-powered Voice and Unified Communications capabilities. You will partner with AI, data, product, and platform teams to build scalable, observable systems that deliver dependable insights and resilient customer experiences.

What you will be doing:

• Run and improve production environments that support AI and AI workloads, data pipelines, analytics applications, and customer-facing services.

• Build software and automation to manage cloud infrastructure, data platforms, model-serving infrastructure, and application services.

• Define and measure service level indicators, service level objectives, and error budgets for AI and analytics services, including availability, data freshness, pipeline completion, and inference latency.

• Build end-to-end observability that correlates metrics, logs, and traces with data-quality signals, AI-service performance, and customer impact.

• Monitor and optimize the reliability, performance, capacity, and cost of batch and streaming workloads, analytics queries, and inference services.

• Partner with data engineering and machine-learning teams to make ingestion, transformation, feature, training, deployment, and reporting workflows production-ready.

• Automate CI/CD and production-readiness checks for data pipelines, model and prompt releases, schema changes, analytics applications, and dashboards.

• Detect and resolve data-quality incidents involving missing, stale, delayed, or anomalous data, schema drift, and broken lineage or dependencies.

• Design and test graceful degradation, dependency isolation, retry and fallback patterns, and recovery procedures for impaired AI, data, or downstream services.

• Improve the reliability of AI-powered Voice and Unified Communications capabilities such as speech recognition, transcription, summarization, intelligent routing, conversational assistance, and text-to-speech.

• Establish operational monitoring for model and AI-service behavior, including latency, throughput, error rates, drift indicators, and changes in output quality.

• Plan capacity and run performance, load, and resilience tests across compute-intensive AI workloads, distributed data processing, and analytics services.

• Lead incident response and post-incident improveme

title: Payroll Accountant
description:
Payroll Accountant - Remote | U.S. Payroll, ADP, Gusto & Reconciliations
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
About the Role
At Pavago , one of our clients is hiring a detail-oriented Payroll Accountant to manage end-to-end U.S. payroll processing, payroll accounting, tax compliance, and reconciliations.
You’ll be responsible for ensuring 50-500 employees are paid accurately and on time , payroll taxes are properly handled, and all payroll records remain clean, compliant, and audit-ready.
This role is ideal for someone with hands-on experience in ADP, Gusto, Paychex, QuickBooks Payroll, or similar payroll systems who understands both payroll processing and the accounting behind it.
What You’ll Own
U.S. Payroll Processing

• Process bi-weekly, semi-monthly, and monthly payrolls

• Manage payroll for approximately 50-500 employees

• Review and validate:

• Time entries and overtime

• Bonuses and commissions

• Deductions and adjustments

• New hires and terminations

• Process payroll through ADP, Gusto, Paychex, QuickBooks Payroll, or BambooHR

• Ensure payroll is accurate and completed on schedule

Payroll Accounting & Reconciliations

• Prepare and post payroll journal entries

• Reconcile payroll clearing accounts, bank activity, and general ledger balances

• Accurately record benefits, deductions, taxes, and employer contributions

• Work with accounting platforms including QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero

• Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies quickly

Payroll Tax & Compliance

• Manage federal, state, and local payroll tax requirements

• Support preparation and filing of:

• Form 941

• W-2s

• 1099s

• Applicable state and local filings

• Maintain accurate compliance documentation

• Stay current with U.S. payroll regulations and filing requirements

Benefits & Employee Support

• Reconcile healthcare, retirement, and other benefit contributions

• Verify payroll deductions against employee elections

• Support new-hire payroll setup and onboarding

• Respond professionally to questions involving pay stubs, direct deposits, deductions, and tax updates

Payroll Reporting

• Prepare payroll, headcount, and variance reports

• Provide payroll data to finance and HR teams

• Support audits with accurate payroll documentation

• Analyze payroll results against budgets when required

Process Improvement

• Document and maintain payroll SOPs

• Identify opportunities to improve payroll accuracy and efficiency

• Use Excel, integrations, and automation to streamline workflows

Requirements

• 2+ years of payroll processing experience

• Strong hands-on experience with at least one:

• ADP

• Gusto

• Paychex

• QuickBooks Payroll

• BambooHR

• Strong understanding of U.S. payroll taxes and compliance

• Experience with payroll journal entries and reconciliations

• Intermediate Excel / Google Sheets skills, including:

• Pivot Tables

• VLOOKUP

• Reconciliations

• High attention to detail and numerical accuracy

• Ability to investigate and resolve discrepancies quickly

• Strong organizational and deadline-management skills

• Comfortable working remotely during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

•
Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC)

• Multi-state payroll experience

• International payroll exposure

• Experience reconciling payroll to accounting systems

• NetSuite or Xero experience

• Familiarity with HRIS integrations such as BambooHR, Workday, or Zenefits

Tools & Systems
Payroll: ADP, Gusto, Paychex, QuickBooks Payroll, BambooHR
Accounting: QuickBooks, NetSuite, Xero
Reporting: Excel, Google Sheets
HRIS: BambooHR, Workday or similar systems
What Success Looks Like

• 100% on-time payroll processing

• Less than 1% payroll error rate

• Payroll tax filings completed before deadlines

• Discrepancies resolved within 2 business days

• Accurate payroll journal entries and reconciliations

• Clean, organized, audit-ready payroll records

title: Principal Business Consultant - Commercial
description:

We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.
The Role
As a Principal Consultant in our Commercial Business Consulting practice, you won’t just advise on the future of Life Sciences - you’ll be building it. We help our customers bring treatments to patients faster by fundamentally transforming their operating models, powered by the industry’s most advanced technology, AI and data. Unlike traditional firms, we move beyond "slides and theory" to deliver tangible, scalable execution that others simply cannot replicate.
What You’ll Do

•
Project Mastery: Act as the Lead for Veeva BC’s largest and most complex global projects, maintaining full accountability for excellence across multiple teams

•
Strategic Growth: Lead and own Business Development for Commercial BC , focusing on architecting and winning key deals exceeding $1M+

•
People Leadership: Manage and mentor high-performing consulting teams, taking responsibility for the professional growth and delivery standards of the practice

•
Thought Leadership: Develop and champion industry-leading thought leadership in Commercial/Medical/Tech/AI to keep Veeva at the cutting edge of Life Sciences

•
Customer Success: Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite stakeholders, leveraging Veeva’s data and software to solve their most critical challenges

Requirements

•
Experience: 10+ years of Life Sciences Consulting experience (Management Consulting preferred)

•
Track Record: Proven ability to win and deliver $1M+ consulting engagements

•
Leadership: Extensive experience managing multiple project teams and senior-level customer relationships

•
Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher

Nice to Have

• Knowledge of Veeva products

• Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

• Follow the application process and submit your resume.

• Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.

• Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.

• If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

• A conversation with the hiring manager

• A practical case exercise

• A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.

• Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

•
Compensation: Highly competitive salary and equity in Veeva

•
Growth: Unrivalled career progression in a fast-growing, global team

•
Flexibility: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day

Compensation

Join Us as a Clinical Research Associate (Level II) - Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation
We have successfully supported the top 50 pharmaceutical companies and more than 750 biotechs, spanning 2,700 clinical trials across 100+ countries in the last 5 years.

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. As a Clinical Research Associate (Level II), you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.
What You’ll Do:
• Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
• Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential
• investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
• Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
• Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
• Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
• Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
• Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Synthomer is a leading supplier of high-performance, highly specialised polymers and ingredients that play vital roles in key sectors such as coatings, construction, adhesives, and health and protection - growing markets that serve billions of end users worldwide. Headquartered in London, UK and publicly listed there since 1971, we employ c.3,900 employees across our 5 innovation centres of excellence and more than 29 manufacturing sites across Europe, North America and Asia. Around 20% of our sales volumes are from new and patent protected products.
At our innovation centres of excellence in the UK, Germany, China, Malaysia and Ohio, USA we collaborate closely with our customers to develop new products and enhance existing ones tailored to their needs, with an increasing range of sustainability benefits. Since 2021, we have been proud holders of the London Stock Exchange Green Economy Mark, which recognises green technology businesses making a significant contribution to a more sustainable, low-carbon economy.

Data Scientist

Turn data into business value
Location: Home-based (Netherlands, Belgium or United Kingdom)
Type: Full-time

At Synthomer , we're investing in data, analytics, and artificial intelligence to transform how we operate and make decisions. To support this ambition, we are expanding our new Digital Centre of Excellence and are looking for a talented Data Scientist to help drive innovation across the business.
If you're passionate about solving complex problems, building predictive models, and creating tangible business impact through data, we'd love to hear from you.

Your impact
As a Data Scientist, you'll transform data into actionable insights, develop advanced analytical solutions, and help shape the next generation of digital capabilities at Synthomer . You'll work alongside Data Engineers, Data Translators, and business stakeholders to develop end-to-end solutions that create measurable value.

What you'll be doing

• Explore, prepare, and refine datasets for advanced analytics and machine learning.

• Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.

• Develop predictive and prescriptive models using statistical and machine learning techniques.

• Design feature engineering strategies to maximize model performance.

• Communicate insights through visualizations, presentations, and dashboards.

• Deploy machine learning models and monitor performance in production environments.

• Support and promote the use of AI, advanced analytics, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

What we're looking for

• 2-5 years of experience in Data Science, Analytics, or Machine Learning.

• Strong knowledge of statistics, predictive modelling, and machine learning techniques.

• Proficiency in Python, SQL, Databricks, and Apache Spark.

• Experience working with cloud-based analytics platforms.

• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex insights to business stakeholders.

• A curious mindset and passion for innovation and continuous learning.

Why join Synthomer ?

• Play a key role in building a world-class Digital Centre of Excellence.

• Work on high-impact AI and advanced analytics projects.

• Collaborate with global teams across manufacturing, commercial, operational, and corporate functions.

• Enjoy the flexibility of a home-based role.

• Help shape the future of digital innovation in a leading global specialty chemicals business.

Are you our new teammember! We're looking forward to hear from you!

title: Enterprise Sales Director
description:
About us

We are Digital Science and we are advancing the research ecosystem.
We are a pioneering technology company, and our vision is of a future where a trusted and collaborative research ecosystem drives progress for all. We believe in better, open, collaborative and inclusive research. In creating the next generation of tools and working in partnership with the community we tackle some of the biggest challenges to research. In order to achieve our vision, we need innovative, inspiring and dynamic people to join our team. Want to join us?
Your new role - The Sales Director within the Digital Science Enterprise Segment drives top-line revenue growth by owning the full commercial sales cycle across our integrated portfolio, including Dimensions , Altmetric , ReadCube , Figshare , and metaphacts . This role is responsible for driving pipeline generation, rigorous deal qualification, framing client-centric value propositions, aligning portfolio solutions with enterprise strategic objectives, and leading pricing and contracting negotiations.

High priority is placed on a solid conceptual and domain understanding of Knowledge Graph architecture , semantic ontologies , the Semantic Layer , and Agentic AI solutions . Technical skills are desired but not required.

What you’ll be doing

Pipeline Generation & Prospecting

• Proactively identify, target, and initiate strategic conversations with C-suite leaders, R&D executives, and data architects across Life Sciences, BioPharma, and research-intensive enterprises.

• Execute territory plans to build a high-volume, high-quality sales pipeline across the full Digital Science capability set.

• Position Digital Science 's unique portfolio advantage-leveraging connections between grants, patents, publications, clinical trials, and knowledge graphs.

Deal Qualification & Opportunity Management

• Apply structured qualification frameworks to evaluate enterprise leads and focus resources on high-probability opportunities.

• Manage and prioritize enterprise opportunities based on deal value.

title: Account Executive
description:
ABOUT SITELINE

Siteline is a fast-growing Series A startup transforming how construction companies get paid, headquartered in San Francisco.

Specialty trade contractors build the infrastructure America runs on, from data centers and schools to highways and hospitals. Yet most are still managing millions of dollars in billing and payments through spreadsheets and manual processes.

We’re changing that.

WHAT PROBLEMS ARE WE SOLVING

Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. For those 96 days, subcontractors are funding payroll, materials, equipment, and the cost of actually doing the work - all before seeing a single payment. It’s little wonder they describe themselves as “America’s largest bank”.

Our mission is simple: get subcontractors paid faster. And we’re damn good at it. Siteline customers average just 55 days to payment, and that number keeps falling.

We’re building in a massive, underserved market with no true direct competitor. And while AI is reshaping industries everywhere, the physical infrastructure our customers build isn’t going anywhere. Data centers, hospitals, schools, roads, and power infrastructure still have to be built -and the contractors building them need a radically better way to manage their receivables.

WHY ARE WE BUILDING THIS?

Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

These businesses are managing millions of dollars on spreadsheets, printouts, ERP reports, and a whole lot of manual work to get paid.

Every project has different billing requirements, different deadlines, and different paperwork. Miss something, and payment can get pushed out another 30 days.

Subcontractors deserve software built specifically for them. That’s why we built Siteline.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Account Executive to join us at a pivotal stage of our growth. We’ve built a sales playbook that works, now we’re looking for great sellers to execute it and help us scale. The entire US is your territory. You’ll own deals end-to-end, work directly with our Head of Sales, and have close access to Marketing and Product as we continue to grow.

This is a role for someone who loves to sell; competitive, curious, coachable, and hungry to win. You love the hunt: prospecting, cold calling, creating your own pipeline, and turning a cold account into a closed deal.

You know how to create urgency, run a tight process, and close. You’ll get the upside and impact of an early-stage startup, with a proven playbook ready to execute.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• 4+ years of closing experience as an AE in tech with a consistent track record of achieving sales targets (bonus: experience in construction technology)

• Experience selling $30k+ ACV deals in a quick sales cycle (30-60 days) to mid market companies

• Experience selling to finance functions (CFOs, Controllers, AR Managers) and/or tech laggard industries (AEC, manufacturing, agriculture, real estate, healthcare, etc.)

• Experience selling against the status quo - creating urgency and convincing customers to move away from spreadsheets, manual processes, or legacy systems.

• Ability to own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demo, negotiation, and close.

• You’re a hunter. This is an outbound-first role, and you’ll self-source 50%+ of your pipeline through cold outreach, referrals, and creative prospecting. You have a track record of building and closing pipeline you generated yourself, and genuinely enjoy doing it.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup environment where cross-functional collaboration is key.

• Willingness to travel 10% for on-site demos and trade shows

• Bonus: Experience selling a product that integrates with ERPs

WHAT WE OFFER

Hi, I'm Alessio, I lead IT Operations at voize. We're growing fast, and I'm hiring someone who can turn that growth into structure.

You'll also be the escalation point when issues go beyond what normal support can handle. Instead of just closing the ticket, you fix why it happened, and you're already building solutions for problems before anyone's even raised them. The work changes week to week, but the standard doesn't.

- Automate the manual layer. Wherever a process depends on someone doing the same thing by hand, you find a way to automate it, so the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a person.

- Networks and infrastructure that hold up. Office networks, Wi-Fi, VPN and internal infrastructure aren’t a side topic for you. You keep them reliable and secure as we grow, and you weigh up where local hosting makes sense and where the cloud does.

- Choosing the right tools, and proving it first. When we need a new tool or a better vendor, you run the evaluation: you scope the requirements, run proofs of concept, and negotiate. You also run the service reviews afterwards, so what we buy keeps delivering.

- Hands on with Jamf and Google Workspace especially, and comfortable across a modern SaaS stack. You've owned an MDM instance, not just used one.

title: Certified Weld Inspector (CWI) - Memphis
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Certified Weld Inspector to support the buildout of SpaceXSI's high-performance data centers. In this hands-on role, you will inspect welds on industrial piping and structural steel and keep quality moving on our next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with welding, mechanical, structural, and operations teams to verify weld quality from construction through turnover. This is a full-time, onsite role with significant travel to SpaceXSI data center sites. This is an hourly position with overtime.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Inspect welds in progress and at completion on large-bore industrial piping and structural steel, and accept or reject them against the applicable code, welding procedure specification (WPS), and drawings.

• Interpret AWS, ASME, and project specifications against isometric, spool, structural, and arrangement drawings.

• Monitor GTAW, SMAW, FCAW, and GMAW work and confirm it is performed to the qualified welding procedure.

• Verify and document welder qualifications before a welder is released to weld on the package.

• Check joint design and preparation, fit-up, cleanliness, tack quality, preheat, interpass temperature, and interpass and final cleaning.

• Verify base metal and filler metal against the applicable specifications, including control and handling of welding consumables.

• Recommend and verify repairs, then visually inspect the completed repair before the joint is released.

• Oversee nondestructive examination and any required proof or mechanical testing, and confirm fabrication and inspection records are complete.

• Record inspection results and communicate findings to construction, welding, and engineering.

• Review contractor welding and inspection practices on site.

• Follow hot-work, LOTO, PPE, and site rules; report rejected welds, unsafe conditions, and drawing conflicts immediately.

• Support punch-list and NDE hold points through system turnover.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Current American Welding Society (AWS) Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification.

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience visually inspecting welded industrial piping and/or structural steel in the field.

• Working knowledge of ASME Section IX and AWS D1.1.

• Nondestructive testing Level II, in line with ASNT SNT-TC-1A, in visual testing (VT), magnetic particle (MT), liquid penetrant (PT), ultrasonic (UT), or phased array ultrasonic (PAUT).

• Prior experience on data center, industrial, or heavy-civil construction sites.

• Willingness to work at heights, outdoors, and on a changing data center construction site.

• Strong safety mindset and willingness to follow site procedures, including hot-work permits and inspection hold points.

• Willingness to work extended hours, nights, and weekends during critical construction windows.

• OSHA 10 or equivalent training.

• Ability to read isometric, spool, structural, and weld-map drawings and to record inspection results on a computer.

At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

At Cribl, we are evolving our data organization from a centralized service desk into a dynamic, product-led enablement engine. We are seeking an Analytics Lead to act as our internal data consultant and product owner.

Operating dynamically across multiple business units (GTM, People, Finance, etc.), you will take on ambiguous, complex business challenges and design self-serve data solutions that drive action. You combine the strategic rigor of a management consultant with the technical chops of a senior data practitioner. You won’t just take requests; you will own the “Data UX” for our internal stakeholders. You will go deep with two or three named functions rather than spreading thin across all of them. 

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

• Executive Storytelling & Audience Tailoring: Translate complex analyses into clear, compelling narratives, tailoring insights and recommendations to different audiences to drive decisions.

• Product Mindset: Treat analytics as a product. Learn what users need, rank work by impact, maintain a shared plan, and build analyses people can make decisions from quickly

• Problem Framing & Translation: Turn ambiguous questions into defined requirements, and own the analytics end-to-end.

• Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management: Serve as a strategic thought partner to cross-functional stakeholders, aligning analytical priorities, influencing decisions, and driving clarity on complex business challenges.

• AI tooling: Strategically leverage AI tools to enhance analytical capabilities, improve efficiency, and drive innovation.

• Analytics Liaison: Serve as the data team's subject matter expert on marketing data, providing strategic guidance on campaign performance, lead tracking, attribution, and funnel analytics to support marketing decisions.

• We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours 

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

• 7+ years in analytics, data, or a related role, including direct partnership with senior business leaders.

• Deep knowledge of GTM commercial drivers, with hands-on experience in marketing analytics (e.g., attribution, campaign measurement, funnel analysis), and the ability to learn adjacent functions quickly.

• Proficiency in SQL and familiarity with the modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt) and BI tools with semantic layers (e.g. Omni, Looker, Sigma). Fluency is the bar, not virtuosity: we expect you to use AI-assisted modeling to move faster, and we’d rather have deep business knowledge with competent SQL than the reverse.

• Experience building or directing predictive models (e.g., propensity, churn) and experiments, and judging when their output is good enough to act on.

• A track record of presenting analysis to executives that influenced a decision.

• Strong written communication: you can turn an analysis into a short memo a leader can act on without a meeting.

• Ability to manage competing priorities across stakeholders and decline requests with a clear reason.

title: Trip Leader - Long Term
description:
This is a remote position.

As a Metanoia Expeditions Group Leader you will be required to accompany group members on our tours through Asia, Africa & Europe. You will ultimately be responsible for ensuring that each and every group member has the time of their lives while going over and above to make sure they are comfortable, safe, and happy. You will become everyone’s best friend in the group, be in charge of entertaining, coordinating, guiding, and making sure things go smoothly!

• There are some admin elements to the job such as coordinating with local partners & drivers, keeping track of expenses, sending welcome emails prior to the trip, staying in contact with groups, engaging on social media, and getting in reviews after the tour (a super important part of the job!)

• Generally helping to promote Metanoia Expeditions and its products through social media

A Group Leader’s role requires a lot of energy and enthusiasm. You will be required to work abroad independently and fly frequently back and forth. • Be located in Mumbai, Bangalore or Delhi

• Speak English and Hindi fluently and be able to converse easily in both languages.

• Have travel experience abroad

• Be confident enough to lead a group of up to 20-30 people and communicate with them effectively.

• Be confident and capable enough to handle the health and safety of your group in, at times, an extremely unpredictable environment and be able to respond accordingly if things go wrong.

• Be thorough, accurate and timely with all your admin duties.

• Be outgoing and personable with an enthusiastic attitude and be able to relate to and get along with people from all different walks of life, ages and mindsets.

IMPORTANT: Please read the following BEFORE applying for this job.

Being a Metanoia Expeditions Group leader is an awesome opportunity where you will have unforgettable experiences and make friends and memories to last a lifetime! However, it will most definitely be a lot harder than you are imagining and there can be downsides to the role which you must be aware of and fully understand and consider before applying;

• You are not on holiday, your group members are. It is your primary responsibility to make sure their trip is safe, enjoyable and runs as smoothly as possible. You should not apply for the Group Leader role if your sole reason is because you want to travel.

• You are there to give EVERY single group member the best experience possible. If you can only give that experience to 80% of your Group, then please reconsider your application.

title: Staff Software Engineer - AI Compute, Together Cloud
description:
About the Role

Together AI is building the AI Native Cloud, an end-to-end platform for the full generative AI lifecycle, combining the fastest LLM inference engine with state-of-the-art GPU cloud infrastructure. The Together Cloud team builds the [Together GPU Clusters](https://www.together.ai/gpu-clusters) flagship IaaS product that provides high-performance, AI-ready GPU clusters through a self-serve cloud console, along with the virtualized infrastructure layer powering Together's inference, RL, and fine-tuning products.

As a Staff Software Engineer focusing on AI Compute in the Together Cloud org, you will set technical direction for and build major components of the next generation AI cloud platform - a highly available, global cloud infrastructure with cutting-edge virtualization of the latest ML hardware: GB300s/VRs, BlueField DPUs, InfiniBand and dual/quad-plane RoCEv2 fabrics. That virtualized computing platform powers our own SaaS products - inference, RL, and fine-tuning - and serves external cloud customers through self-serve offerings such as on-demand/reserved Kubernetes/Slurm clusters, across dozens of data centers and hundreds of thousands of GPUs.

This is an architect-and-build role. Fully automated bootstrapping of GPU data centers, high-performance virtualization of GPU compute and DC networking without compromising isolation or portability, and fault-tolerant decentralized control planes - you'll set the architecture for these across our global and in-DC services, and be a key owner of the hardest parts, in the code as well as the design. Your designs will span the IaaS layer of a greenfield Vera Rubin data center up to the global management plane that schedules capacity across all of them. At this level the job is as much leverage as code: the standards you set and the engineers you grow decide how fast the rest of Together Cloud ships.

Responsibilities

• Own the GPU and network virtualization stack: the hypervisor, kernel, and SDN work that keeps GPU compute and DC networking high-performance, portable, and strongly isolated across heterogeneous hardware.

• Own the in-DC IaaS layer: architect and roadmap the services, Kubernetes operators, and libraries that provision and manage compute, storage, and networks in our data centers - VMs, parallel filesystems, VPCs, and InfiniBand partitions; lead its build-out for a new Vera Rubin data center with thousands of GPUs, from hardware bring-up to customer-facing API.

• Design the GPU scheduling and global management plane: the distributed control plane behind on-demand and reserved clusters across dozens of data centers, including the systems that scale per-cluster limits and automate the onboarding of new capacity.

• Architect monitoring and automated remediation for fault tolerance: the strategy for automated detection, isolation, and recovery of failed nodes that keeps distributed pretraining and large-scale inference running through hardware failures.

• Set technical direction across teams: lead design reviews, resolve cross-cutting architectural disagreements, unblock cross-team dependencies and integration risks, and define the standards other engineers build against - measured in cluster reliability, time-to-first-GPU on new capacity, and quality at scale.

• Grow the team: mentor senior and junior engineers, deepen the team's expertise in virtualization, DC networking, and GPU infrastructure, and help raise the hiring bar for Together Cloud.

• Set the engineering bar: create the testing frameworks, tools, and developer documentation that make our systems robust and usable by other teams, and shape the core, open-source Together AI platform.

To be successful you'll need to be deeply technical and an excellent communicator - expert software development fundamentals, deep systems knowledge and troubleshooting instincts, and the leadership and diplomacy skills to align teams that don't report to you. Here's what you'll be doing:

You'll conduct real-time video consultations with patients via the Fresh platform, assess their suitability for cosmetic injectable treatments, and where clinically appropriate and within your endorsed scope of practice, prescribe Schedule 4 medicines and issue treatment authorisations for Fresh Clinic treating nurses.

Contemporaneous Documentation: Maintain thorough records for all consultations-including declined treatments-and capture informed consent using app templates.

•
Safety & Escalation: Escalate clinical concerns and adverse events promptly through Fresh's governance channels.

• Current Ahpra registration as a Nurse Practitioner with no conditions, undertakings, or restrictions

• Endorsement to prescribe Schedule 4 medicines within your scope of practice

• Demonstrated experience in cosmetic and aesthetic medicine

Summary

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer - Maritime Optimization

Level: Senior; 5+ years of professional software engineering experience

Clearance: Ability to obtain a clearance

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a Senior Software Engineer - Maritime Optimization. This hands-on software engineering role will develop maritime route optimization, vessel performance modeling, and voyage analysis capabilities for U.S. Government and defense customers. You will refine optimization algorithms, translate vessel performance and fuel-consumption models into software, and build simulation and evaluation tools that make route recommendations clear and explainable.

Our client is an ocean technology company that designs, builds, and deploys marine sensors and combines oceanographic and underwater acoustic sensing with data and software. Its capabilities help commercial customers increase efficiency and reduce emissions, while helping government and defense stakeholders understand ocean conditions, maritime activity, and remote environments. The company has more than a decade of Navy research partnerships and is expanding its established capabilities into funded federal programs.

What will you do

You will work on maritime route optimization, vessel performance modeling, and voyage analysis capabilities for U.S. Government and defense customers. This is a hands-on software engineering role working directly on software that models vessel performance and evaluates candidate maritime routes. Depending on the problem, you may refine optimization algorithms, translate vessel performance and fuel-consumption models into software, build simulation and evaluation tooling, or improve how route recommendations are scored and explained.

Develop maritime voyage optimization and route evaluation capabilities.

Model vessel performance and fuel consumption across varying operating and environmental conditions.

Account for voyage constraints, transit time, fuel efficiency, and operational considerations in route recommendations.

Improve optimization algorithms and the software that supports them.

Build simulation and evaluation capabilities to understand optimizer behavior and route quality.

Produce clear, explainable results that allow users to understand and evaluate optimization recommendations.

Collaborate with engineers, product experts, and maritime domain specialists to translate real-world problems into practical software solutions.

Work across high- and low-level languages, including Rust and Python, contributing to algorithms, models, services, APIs, testing, and related software components.

Contribute to existing technology and new software developed for government maritime applications as these capabilities evolve.

Requirements

5+ years of professional software engineering experience.

Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience contributing to production software.

Experience with Python and/or a compiled language such as Rust, C++, C, or similar.

Comfort working with algorithms, data structures, and computational problems.

Ability to translate domain or mathematical concepts into maintainable, testable software.

Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset when working across engineering and domain disciplines.

Comfort working on software supporting U.S. Government and Department of Defense customers. Previous defense experience is not required.

Maritime route optimization experience is not required. Relevant experience may come from robotics, logistics, aerospace, autonomy, transportation, scientific computing, operations research, simulation, or other domains involving optimization of physical systems.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

title: Chief Legal Officer (CLO)
description:
Role Summary
The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

• Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.

• Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.

• Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.

• Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.

• Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.

• Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.

• Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

• Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.

• Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.

• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.

• Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

• Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.

• Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.

• Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.

• Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

• Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.

• Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.

• Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.

• Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

• Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.

• Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.

• Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.

• Support post-merger integration activities from a legal perspective.

7. Ethics, Compliance & Corporate Integrity

• Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.

• Oversee whistleblower programs, investigations, and ethics policies.

• Ensure adherence to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and corporate conduct standards.

• Lead internal investigations involving legal and compliance matters.

8. Legal Team Leadership

• Build and lead a high-performing legal and compliance function.

• Manage legal budgets and external counsel expenditures.

• Develop legal talent and succession planning initiatives.

• Establish legal operations processes and performance metrics.

Qualifications & Experience

• Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent law degree.

• Licensed attorney admitted to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.

• 15+ years of progressive legal experience.

• Minimum 5+ years in a senior legal leadership role (General Counsel, CLO, Head of Legal, Legal Director).

• Experience advising executive leadership and boards of directors.

• Strong background in corporate law, governance, compliance, commercial contracts, and regulatory matters.

• Experience managing complex legal transactions and litigation.
